source_control_definitions.action: For each actual subject login on A, execute the common sequence, then exactly one separate named scenario. R or G must commit its authorized change before A issues its next protected statement. A uses its original now-stale grant and must be denied, without a forbidden source mutation or protected disclosure. Rollback A after observation; do not roll back or mislabel the legitimate separate owner change. Revocation, Identity security-generation change and Customer source-generation change are distinct runs.
source_control_definitions.expected: Every named committed revocation/generation change is seen by A currentness checks; the stale protected action has no unauthorized mutation/effect/disclosure. All cases remain NOT_RUN until separately authorized execution.

mandatory_unprepared_vectors.reason: Separate exact renew/reclaim/concurrent-higher-fence statement plan required; no elapsed-expiry success invented.
Needs a retained committed effect followed by controlled higher-fence reclaim; not the one-success path.
Every exposed branch and complete foreign/minus-cap snapshots require separately reviewed SQL variants.
Needs authentic noncurrent prior selection and exact previous evidence; no direct worker grants widened.
Wrong enum/PK/revision/extra keys and source-transaction variants require exact diagnostic+marker/full rollback observers, not generic P0001 acceptance.

failure_contract: Stop this and all later behavioral scenarios on unexpected result. Persist only completed stage names, allowlisted comparison Booleans/counts/SQLSTATE+exact source diagnostic class and safe failure class. Close the affected operation backend before observations. No passwords, handles, raw stderr, raw probe dictionaries, statement bodies or lease preimages in evidence. Retain controlled cleanup identity and exact resource ownership boundaries.
qualification_limits: Source proposal only: every dependency/case remains NOT_RUN; no selected control or94/451 promotion.
Independent fixture facts never establish real owner authorization/catalog publication or source/worker behavior.
Actual app source creation, app schedule, worker claim and worker enrollment must happen through their actual restricted logins; privileged observers cannot provide these proofs.
No canonical SQL/fixtures/ACL/source packet edits, usage writes, Privacy execution, provider calls, P0-D adapter, normal network delivery or deployment.
